results.question: 快速示例如何准备模型仓库？
reference_points: clone r26.09，进入 server/docs/examples，执行 fetch_models.sh。

evidence.quote:
git clone -b r26.09 https://github.com/triton-inference-server/server.git
cd server/docs/examples
./fetch_models.sh

results.question: 快速示例启动服务时挂载什么目录，加载什么模型？
reference_points: model_repository 挂 /models，模型仓库 /models，explicit 模式加载 densenet_onnx。

evidence.quote: docker run --gpus=1 --rm --net=host -v ${PWD}/model_repository:/models nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:26.09-py3 tritonserver --model-repository=/models --model-control-mode explicit --load-model densenet_onnx

results.question: 自己的模型交给 Triton 前需要准备什么？
reference_points: 模型放进 model repository；按模型类型和能力需要可能建立 model configuration。

evidence.quote:
The first step in using Triton to serve your models is to place one or
more models into a [model repository](docs/user_guide/model_repository.md). Depending on
the type of the model and on what Triton capabilities you want to enable for
the model, you may need to create a [model
configuration](docs/user_guide/model_configuration.md) for the model.
